where: verify/texts.js packContents / packDatasheet (gate coverage, catalogue and list rows of Chaos Daemons)
why: The Daemons Faction Pack 1.2 prints all 53 datasheets in full under “Index: Chaos Daemons” (contents line “Index: Chaos Daemons…2”, no datasheet names), so packContents finds no “Datasheets” group and packDatasheet checks 0 Daemons units against GW’s printed datasheet (checked count 32, all other factions). With the check enabled for chaos-daemons (probe: page found by the datasheet’s name) 168 Daemons abilities are checked and it fails on Disciples of Be’lakor, Horticulous Slimux’s Leader and Infected Outbreak (plus Leader-text format and GW misprints to allow for). Keywords, the CORE line and ability tags are compared only with Wahapedia at import time, never with the pack: the three Tormentbringer errors passed that way.

fix.code: verify/texts.js: when a pack’s contents have an “Index: <faction>” entry, treat the pages from it to the next top entry as the Datasheets group and find each unit’s page by its name (as now); compare Leader texts by unit list, not by “units:/unit: ■” wording; and add a pack check of KEYWORDS, CORE and ability tags for every row whose datasheet the pack prints.
